author: Lon.TV
description:
Two of my favorite retro machines of all time, the 3DO and the Apple IIgs, now have working beta cores running on the MiSTer's FPGA. They still have some bugs to work out, but so far things are looking great. See more MiSTer - https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLCZHp4d1HnIsu43ZJ6R3cbDYgLH5ZQULh and subscribe! http://lon.tv/s
